response.text: I'll start by verifying the key areas with set-based queries.

arguments.sql: select h."JRNL_NO", h."PRD_ID", h."POST_DT", sum(l."DR_AMT") dr, sum(l."CR_AMT") cr from "GLJRNH" h join "GLJRNL" l on l."JRNL_NO"=h."JRNL_NO" group by 1,2,3 having sum(l."DR_AMT")<>sum(l."CR_AMT")

select h."JRNL_NO", h."PRD_ID", h."POST_DT", h."SRC_CD", h."SRC_REF", p."STRT_DT", p."END_DT", p."CLOSE_DT", p."STAT_CD" from "GLJRNH" h join "GLPERD" p on p."PRD_ID"=h."PRD_ID" where h."POST_DT" not between p."STRT_DT" and p."END_DT" or (p."STAT_CD"='C' and h."POST_DT">p."CLOSE_DT")

select l."JRNL_NO", l."LN_SEQ", l."ACCT_CD", l."DR_AMT", l."CR_AMT", c."ACCT_CD" c, c."ACTV_FLG" from "GLJRNL" l left join "GLCOA" c on trim(c."ACCT_CD")=trim(l."ACCT_CD") where c."ACCT_CD" is null or c."ACTV_FLG"<>'Y'
